name: cy-grad-compass
description: 毕业设计项目生成与管理工具

scripts.dev: npm run prepare:electron-runtime && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test "scripts/*.test.cjs" "dist-electron/database/*.test.js" "dist-electron/tests/*.test.js" && vitest run
scripts.seed: npm run build && npm run prepare:electron-runtime && electron scripts/seed-demo-data.cjs
scripts.smoke: npm run build && npm run prepare:electron-runtime && electron scripts/smoke-check.cjs
